title: Hollow and Salt
author: Wendell Thackeray
blurb: Beatrix Thackeray, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
